chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, forbade riding upon the sea during its turbulence.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, say about traveling by sea during rough conditions?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, prohibited traveling by sea when it is turbulent. It indicates a legal and precautionary ruling concerning dangerous conditions during sea travel.
